messages:
Sam: Heads-up: Visitor arriving at 10:40 with a compact stroller and a folded mobility scooter. They asked about short-term accessible parking and if we have a small ramp to get from curb to foyer. Also a perishable delivery (lunch box) coming ~10:00.
frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-reg: Rivera Consulting  1 guest, ETA 10:40. Parking request: accessible. Pre-print badge ready. Reply 'assign' to reserve spot.
Nora: I can reserve the west accessible spot for 10:00-12:00. Do we want the visitor to use a yellow visitor badge + high-vis lanyard?
Facilities: Portable ramp available. We can drop it at west entrance by 10:25. Will also leave a folding hand truck at the loading dock.
Ben: I'll meet them at the foyer at 10:35 and escort to the service elevator (wider). I'll also make sure the cart isn't in use for the catering drop.
postmaster-bot: Package inbound: "Lina farewell - sandwiches and salads" ETA 10:00. Stored in kitchen fridge on arrival. Note: Do not open before 12:30.
Sam: Great. frontdesk-bot, please assign West-A1 and mark "escort assigned" to Ben. Also ensure check-in logs capture mobility device type + serial.
frontdesk-bot: Parking assigned: West-A1. Escort: Ben. Check-in checklist queued for front desk staff.
Facilities: Ramp will be staged at west entrance. Gloves and non-slip mats left in supplies cabinet C.
Nora: I've updated the calendar and emailed the visitor the QR check-in link. Ben, I'll ping you if the ETA shifts.
Ben: Sounds good. I'll bring extra blankets in case the scooter needs padding in the elevator.
Sam: Thanks team. I'll close this thread when guest has checked in.
